    <h1>World of Warcraft setup</h1>
    <p class="lede">Switching on a WoW version, who adds characters, raid templates and role sets.</p>

<main class="doc guide">
<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
The World of Warcraft module brings raid sign-ups by class and spec, characters with their realms, the current raids as ready-made templates, and loot for your guild. Finish [**Setting up Alagos**](/guides/setting-up/) first.

## 1. Switch it on

Run `/guild-settings modules` and press **Switch on** beside your version of the game:

- **WoW: Mists of Pandaria Classic**, the current Classic progression;
- **WoW: Midnight (retail)**, the current expansion;
- **WoW: Forever**, original Azeroth reimagined.

A guild that plays more than one switches each on: a character in one version is a separate character from one in another. The version's tab appears in `/guild-settings show`.

Switching it off later hides it and keeps everything: switching it back on brings it all back. A game you switch off can be switched on again after 7 days, or within 10 minutes if it was a misclick.

## 2. Who adds characters

In WoW your members add their own characters, main and alts, with their realm, class and specs. Officers can still add or fix anyone's from the roster.

To change that, open the game's tab in `/guild-settings show` and press **👤 Who adds characters**:

- **Members add their own** (the default);
- **Members ask, an officer approves**: new characters wait in the claim requests;
- **Officers only**.

## 3. Raids from templates

Press **New event** (on the officer panel, or `/event-create`) and pick a template by name. A template fills in the type, the length and the role slots; you give the date and time.

- **Mists of Pandaria Classic:** each raid at 25 (2 tanks, 6 healers, 17 damage) and 10 (2, 3, 5), such as **Siege of Orgrimmar (25)**.
- **Midnight:** each raid as **Normal / Heroic**, which takes any number from 10 to 30 (the template starts at 25: 2 tanks, 5 healers, 18 damage), and **Mythic** at 20 (2, 4, 14), such as **The Venomous Abyss (Mythic)**. Also a Mythic+ night.
- **Forever:** each raid as **flexible**, starting at 25 (2 tanks, 6 healers, 17 damage), such as **Onyxia's Lair (flexible)**: guilds bring different numbers for their strategy. **Start from** also offers 20 and 40.

These are starting points: bring 17 or 22 by changing the slots. Change the slots on any event in its editor (**Sign-ups** → **Role slots**), where **Start from** also offers Tank / Healer / Melee / Ranged. Your own templates go in **📋 Event templates** on the **Features & limits** tab. Not running every raid? With Premium you can hide the templates you don't use there, and the raids in **📚 Game lists**.

## 4. How sign-ups work

The event post has a button for each role. When a member presses one, Alagos picks the spec of theirs that plays it: their main spec first, then their off-spec, then another spec of their class, on their main character first and then their alts. The post shows each name with their spec, like **Nestaron · Holy Paladin**. A member with no character yet is asked to add one first.

Officers still move people between roles and the bench with **👥 Roles**.

## 5. The game's lists

Classes, specs, raids and (in Classic) tier tokens are in **📚 Game lists** on the game's tab. If something new appears in the game before Alagos knows it, add it there for your server.

## 6. Coming from Raid-Helper

Bring your past raids with you. On the **Features & limits** tab press **📥 Import from Raid-Helper** and upload Raid-Helper's event export (the CSV) or an event's JSON from its web view. You see a preview first:

- each past event, with how many signed up, were late, benched, tentative or absent;
- members matched to their claimed characters, with their class and spec;
- what is left out and why: upcoming events (make those in Alagos), events from another Discord server, and events already imported.

Raid-Helper's CSV gives no time zone, so the preview reads times in your server's time zone: press **🕒 Change time zone** if your Raid-Helper uses another. Importing the same file twice adds nothing twice. Free on every plan.

To bring DKP balances, put them in a file with **Name** and **Points** columns and import it in your loot pool (see the **Loot** guide).

## 7. Loot

Make a pool in **💰 Loot pools** on the **Features & limits** tab and choose your guild's system: soft reserve, loot council or wishlists (free), or DKP, Zero-Sum DKP or EPGP (Premium). See the **Loot** guide.
